summary: REPAIR ROUND 5 of TASK-006 (repair_rounds_used 4 -> 5), fixing the two findings from independent review round 5 (reviewer f545fa31), both of which the manager independently verified by reading the code. Round 5 was the closest yet: requirements=PASS, regression=PASS, performance=PASS, with only failure_paths and maintainability failing. The reviewer ALSO independently confirmed the round-4 defect is genuinely closed and that the self-healing design is sound (clear-only, candidates confined to flowStore queued===true, one single nodeId-scoped predicate, can under-clear but provably cannot over-clear), so the design was deliberately left untouched. Changed ONLY src/stores/queueStore.ts (830 -> 900 lines) and src/hooks/useImageGeneratorExecution.ts (119 -> 144 lines). src/components/** was NOT touched: the chosen feedback route avoided needing ImageGeneratorNode.tsx. Scope check: outside=[] protected=[]. FIX 1 (F-R5-1, maintainability): queueStore.ts:639 previously asserted the marker invariant as 当且仅当 (iff). The manager read the code and confirmed the reverse direction is falsified for the ENTIRE running phase, because the executor writes queued:false at job start (imageGenerationExecution.ts:265-267: status loading, queued false). The invariant is now explicitly ONE-DIRECTIONAL: queued:true IMPLIES the node has at least one queued||running job; the reverse is documented as false BY DESIGN, and the old iff wording is named as a corrected over-claim. The measured (marker|status) set {undefined|idle, false|loading, false|success} is cited, and the valuable per-node-versus-guard-scope distinction (marker scope is per node; guard scope is (canvasId+nodeId)) was KEPT verbatim. The prose at :687-718 no longer claims the user-visible window is avoided: it now states what conditional clearing actually guarantees (it never erases a legitimate marker) and records honestly that the n=4 / concurrency=1 / NOT-paused window is reachable (after image 1 finishes, status=success and marker=false while 3 jobs for that node still queue, so canRun=true and the next click is rejected). For that gap the worker chose VISIBLE FEEDBACK over a disabled-button change, because the latter would need ImageGeneratorNode.tsx (outside allowed paths) and would fight the now-documented one-directional invariant: useImageGeneratorExecution.ts:125-128 now calls toast.info on admitted===false using the repo EXISTING global feedback channel (toastStore; ToastContainer is mounted at App.tsx:259), with NO data-field write (writing data.error would turn a rejected click into a visible node error and clobber the just-finished image success display), no dedupe so N rejected clicks give N notices, no layout or appearance change, and the UI queued predicate stays !== true-style (ImageGeneratorNode.tsx:174 untouched). FIX 2 (F-R5-2, failure_paths): queueStore.ts:797 previously did if (healingQueuedMarkers) return;, which DROPPED a nested notification and therefore caused a MISSED heal rather than merely skipping redundant work; the reviewer constructed a case where a subscriber writing nodes during the heal introduced a new stale true that then persisted forever with no further identity change. The guard now DEFERS: a healPending flag is set, and at the loop tail (:884-887) one more pass runs over the LATEST useFlowStore.getState().nodes before exiting; a shared collectQueuedMarkerCandidates helper serves both passes; the zero-candidate early return still happens BEFORE the reentrancy flag and before any write, so F-R3-2 is preserved. The false comment claim that correctness does not depend on the flag was DELETED and replaced by an honest termination argument which explicitly states that each pass reducing the count is NOT sufficient on its own, and gives the real bound (a new pass runs only if a nodes identity-change notification actually occurred during the pass). MANAGER INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION on the static tree with all workers stopped: gate 6/6 PASS exit 0 and tsc --noEmit exit 0 (the gate is BLIND to undo/redo and to both findings, so it is not offered as evidence for them). Both fixes were verified by the manager READING THE SOURCE rather than trusting the report: the one-directional wording with the quoted executor evidence, the iff deletion, the kept scope clarification, the toast branch with no data write, the healPending deferral with the fresh-nodes re-run, and the deletion of the false flag claim are all present exactly as described. Regression sweep re-run by the manager, all green: probe-r4-guard2 12/12; probe-batch-chain 15/15; probe-cross-canvas two-canvases-independent; probe-req001-coldstart node-usable; probe-cancel-abort-lock not-a-permanent-lock; probe-reject-timeline no-inconsistency; probe-reject-erases-marker consistent; probe-r3-stranded-canvas-copy not-reproduced; probe-lock-via-ui not-a-permanent-lock; probe-r3-erased-while-queued-paused not-reproduced; probe-r3-finally-churn 0 subscribe hits. F-R4-1 REMAINS FIXED, verified directly: probe-r4-undo-restart prints (2) snapshot contains queued:true=true, (3) after settle marker=false active=0, (4) AFTER Ctrl+Z marker=false active=0, (5) debounced canvas copy queued=false, i.e. the resurrected stale marker is retracted inside undo synchronous stack and the persisted copy is false. The worker additionally supplied MUTATION-BASED DISCRIMINATION PROOFS for both new fixes (restoring the old drop behaviour makes its defer probe FAIL with Y stuck true; restoring the silent return makes its feedback probe FAIL with silent rejections); the manager notes this is strong evidence but verified the FIXED endpoints itself rather than the mutations. NO independent review of THIS candidate has been performed yet and none is claimed; a fresh reviewer is the next step. Two evidence-directory issues reported by the worker and confirmed as pre-existing, left in place because they are outside its allowed paths: probe-r4-attrib2.mjs and probe-r4-undo-attrib.mjs have byte-level encoding corruption and fail at parse; probe-r4-decisive.mjs crashes in its own logging at line 276; and probe-r5-silent-drop-window.mjs and probe-r5-invariant-ux.mjs still assert no-feedback while instrumenting only job counts, making their conclusion lines misleading.
